services.desc: Let's Adventure! Pricing $110 Includes up to 2 Passengers Duration 1.5 Hours About Depending on the direction of the wind, your views may include Ogunquit's beautiful sandy beach, the rocky coastline, and perhaps the majestic Bald Head Cliff. Experience the sensation of the salty sea breeze blowign through your hair, and smell the fresh ocean air. See migratory birds firsthand, and if you're lucky, you might even witness the rich marine life in the area, including seals and sunfish.
